acceptance_criterion: Images built in CI only, non-root, multi-stage, no secrets, health endpoint answers
test_name: EN-10-T1 — Every deployable builds into a hardened image that starts and answers its health endpoint

acceptance_criterion: Images pushed to GHCR from main, tagged with the commit sha
test_name: EN-10-T2 — A push to main publishes each image to GHCR, tagged with the commit sha; a pull request publishes nothing

acceptance_criterion: Kubernetes manifests validated with kubeconform -strict including CRD schemas
test_name: EN-10-T3 — The Kubernetes manifests render and validate strictly, custom resources included, and every workload is hardened

acceptance_criterion: Kind smoke deploy of the staging overlay
test_name: EN-10-T4 — The staging overlay deploys on a kind cluster and every service becomes ready and answers its health endpoint

acceptance_criterion: Migration Job using npm run migrate
test_name: EN-10-T5 — The migration Job runs `npm run migrate -- all` against the database before the workloads, and a second run applies nothing

acceptance_criterion: Terraform for the cluster, network and Redis validated in CI
test_name: EN-10-T6 — The Terraform for the network, the EKS cluster and Redis is formatted, valid and lint-clean

acceptance_criterion: Argo CD syncs staging from the config repo
test_name: EN-10-T7 — Argo CD syncs the staging overlay from this repository, with automated sync and self-heal
